comments.body:
This pull request requires additional validation before any workflows can run on NVIDIA's runners.

Pull request vetters can view their responsibilities [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/vetters).

Contributors can view more details about this message [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/contributors).

Thanks. A couple questions:

1. Are you able to update your code calling `CUDAWorker` to provide a list instead of a comma-separated string?
2. Generally speaking, warnings on workers are less visible to the user, and so less valuable. I'm not sure, but I'd guess that's why the warning for `rmm_async and rmm_pool_size` is in `LocalCUDACluster`.

1. Yes. Looking again, the `dask cuda worker` CLI already turns `--set-rmm-allocator-for-libs` into a list (`CommaSeparatedChoice`), so nothing inside dask-cuda passes a string here; it only matters for someone calling `CUDAWorker(rmm_allocator_external_lib_list="torch,cupy")` directly, which fails character by character today while the same value works with `LocalCUDACluster`. If you'd rather keep `CUDAWorker` list-only, I'm happy to close this.
2. Agreed. I've dropped the worker-side `FutureWarning` and the `rmm_async` change; the PR now only parses the argument.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
